title: Setup with real Claude: a wrong key is refused, then the real key; a custom name, face and vibe; all survive a restart

results.expect: Find your AI card; the Anthropic key row offers to add the key
rows tested; the key row waits for a key

results.note: Add key on the Anthropic key row: opens the Secret box

results.expect: Secret box asks for the Anthropic key
a wrong key is tested and the row says it didn't work, in plain words
results.text:
Anthropic key
found on this PC
didn’t work. It may be old or typed wrong.
Add in secret box

results.note: a wrong key is never offered as Use
Replace key opens the Secret box again

results.expect: the real key row shows works

results.note: more than one AI works: pick the key, not the Claude app
only the key works: Use it

results.expect: name card: What should I call myself?
a name with no letter or number (only an emoji and !!) is refused in plain words
"Chotu 😊 it is." and the face card follows
